scope: Git-LFS hooks generated after metadata copy during Nix shell setup; no copied hook claim is withdrawn. Disable execution while preserving generated bytes.
configuration_before:
[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	filemode = true
	bare = false
	logallrefupdates = false
[lfs]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
configuration_after:

	repositoryformatversion = 0
	filemode = true
	bare = false
	logallrefupdates = false
	hooksPath = /dev/null

	repositoryformatversion = 0
